_note: Controlled vocabulary for the registry. One source of truth: registry.schema.json refers to these lists by name (x-vocab) and tools/reglib.py loads them. A value outside a list is refused by validate.py; it is never coerced. Lists marked origin=source are transcribed from kimmy_v1 and checked against it by validate.py; lists marked origin=work_order are transcribed from WORK_ORDER.md / WORK_ORDER_1a.md; origin=registry lists are added here and logged in registry/changes.json.

object_types.extension_note: ACTOR and CONFLICT come from WO-REG-1a. AUTHORITY (a node of the statute -> regulation -> guidance chain) and FINDING (a report-level statement with its branch) are registry additions, logged as CHG-X01 and CHG-X02.

edge_types.extension_note: authorized_by (DECISION -> AUTHORITY, AUTHORITY -> AUTHORITY), conflict_of (CONFLICT -> ACTOR), recused_from (ACTOR -> DECISION) and concerns (object -> SUBSTANCE / ENDPOINT) are registry additions, logged as CHG-X03.

definitions.OBSERVED: read off a record the registry can name (a source row or a source file cell); no coder judgement between the record and the value
definitions.DERIVED: computed from other claims by a rule a tool in tools/ implements; the rule is named in derived_by
definitions.PROPOSED: a coder's reading or construct; carries the coder and the independence tag; never upgraded by repetition

definitions.VERIFIED: the source was seen and says what the claim says
definitions.CORRECTED: the source was seen and says something else; the record carries the value the source gives
definitions.NOT_FOUND: the source is not where cited (another work at the identifier) or two or more searches found no trace while the channel answered
definitions.UNREACHABLE: could not check: host refused, not indexed, or the source was seen but the claimed value was not

verification_state.rule: derived from (reached, queries, exists, says) by tools/check_citations.citation_state, imported, never typed by hand

definitions.ORIGINATOR: the party that produced the claim
definitions.BLIND: a second party that coded without seeing the originator's value and answered a prior-knowledge probe in the negative
definitions.CONTAMINATED-BY-PRIOR: a second party that had seen, or reports holding, the originator's value or the hypothesis
definitions.NOT_INDEPENDENT: the same party re-coding its own material (Annex A against coded_decisions.csv)

direction.source_rule: kimmy_v1 report section 4: go_ahead = approve/clear/permit/no action; warn = approve with boxed warning, REMS, restrictions or partial limits; hold = delay, require more data, or decline to require data collection; decline = reject, revoke, withdraw, ban

direction_rel_bearer.definition: direction coded relative to the cost-bearer of caution: restrictive = the action imposes the caution cost on the bearer; permissive = the action relieves the bearer of it. Added by NCR-R2d (C08: declining monitoring relieves the utility, so a verb-coded hold reads restrictive while the bearer-relative direction is permissive).

cost_bearer.extension_note: employer added for C11 (night shift), CHG-B11-01

evidence_class.source_note: invitro in coded_decisions.csv (B07) and in_vitro in the RUS-0.1 schema are one class; registry is used in B01/B02 and is not in report section 4's list (NCR-N13).

definitions.BELOW_FLOOR: actual less restrictive than the floor (permissive non-conformity)
definitions.ABOVE_CEILING: actual more restrictive than the ceiling (restrictive non-conformity)
definitions.CONFLICT_UNDECLARED: floor > ceiling and no tradeoff declared on the record; the direction of non-conformity is not definable without the declaration
definitions.EXCEPTION_DECLARED: departure compelled by a named instrument that the record itself names
definitions.EXCEPTION_UNDECLARED_PERMISSIVE: departure below the floor compelled by law, not declared as such
definitions.EXCEPTION_UNDECLARED_RESTRICTIVE: departure above the ceiling compelled by law, not declared as such

forcing_kind.source_note: chart4_forcing.png legend: Statute (Delaney Clause), Court order, Failed confirmatory trial, Litigation / post-market harm, New data / scheduled rule. agency_own_study added by NCR-R3b (BVO).

definitions.NOT_ASSESSED: a bounded search of the named corpus found no assessment of this endpoint for this substance
definitions.NOT_REQUIRED: the pathway required no evidence on this endpoint (e.g. 510(k) substantial equivalence)
definitions.NOT_RESOLVED: evidence exists but the exposure or endpoint axis is coded too coarsely to answer the question (e.g. ever/never night work)
definitions.NOT_LOCATED: the absence is asserted by a source but no bounded search was run here

rotation_pattern.definition: night-shift exposure coding required by WORK_ORDER Part B; ever/never coding maps to not_coded

actor_type.extension_note: international_body (IARC, EFSA, EU Commission) and coder (the parties who coded this registry) added; logged CHG-X04

conflict_type.extension_note: disclosure_record is the object that records a search for a disclosure (FOUND / NOT_FOUND / UNREACHABLE); it is how 'absence of a disclosure record = NOT_FOUND, never no conflict' is kept as a node. CHG-X05.

ncr_disposition.qa_note: These are dispositions of the FINDING, not of the item. NQA-1 / App B Criterion XV dispositions of a nonconforming item are accept/use-as-is, reject, repair, rework; see schema/QA_MAPPING.md for the mapping.

definitions.holds: the pattern is consistent with the evidence where tested; inference marked
definitions.scope_limited: consistent only inside a named boundary
definitions.no_data: not testable with the registry's n or frames; reported as not testable
definitions.absent: tested and the evidence runs the other way or shows no association

definitions.T1: C1-C2: one verified source per load-bearing evidence object; one coder
definitions.T2: C3: two independent sources or one primary-depth source; second coder recommended
definitions.T3: C4: two independent verified sources per load-bearing evidence object AND a second coder; anything less is flagged RIGOR_SHORTFALL

agency.extension_note: OSHA (C11) and comparator bodies added; CHG-X06

arm.extension_note: M = comparator (mirror) decision, not in the 33-case sample
